meta.scope: Every Kalshi endpoint path, query parameter, response field, status value, signing rule and doc link that the site code and collectors use, checked against docs.kalshi.com and the official demo API host.
meta.method: Official doc pages read with the page fetcher (chunk by chunk). Live official demo API read-only GETs were made through the same fetcher because the audit sandbox cannot reach kalshi.co directly. No orders were placed and no credentials were used.

result_legend.Confirmed: Code matches the official doc page or live official response read in this audit.
result_legend.Mismatch: Code and official doc disagree; behaviour may be wrong or misleading.
result_legend.Irregularity: Not a wrong API call, but a risk, broken link, undocumented fallback, or unofficial classification that a reviewer must see.
result_legend.Unverified: Could not be confirmed in this audit (page or table not reached). Left open, not assumed.

checks.check: Demo REST and WebSocket hosts used in the site match the official demo page
checks.note: Official recommended REST https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 and WS wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2; alternates demo-api.kalshi.co. Matches the brief's table exactly.

checks.check: Official demo REST host answers read-only requests
checks.note: At audit time: exchange_active true; trading_active true on shards 0–3. Snapshot only; re-check before relying on it.

checks.check: Production host constant in the collector
checks.note: The official server list also names api.elections.kalshi.com; the code does not use it.

checks.check: Status badge covers every official REST market status
checks.note: Official REST statuses: initialized, active, inactive, closed, determined, disputed, amended, finalized. Settled markets appear as finalized in REST.

checks.check: The 'open' view matches the official 'open' filter
checks.note: Official filter mapping: open = active only; unopened = initialized; paused = inactive. The 'open' view therefore includes markets that are not open for trading.
checks.action: Owner of exec-desk: relabel the view or split it into unopened / paused / open (change request CR-1).

checks.check: Collectors use valid GET /markets status filter values
checks.note: Official filter values: unopened, open, closed, settled (paused also documented in the lifecycle page).

checks.check: A market is counted as resolved when its result is known
checks.note: Result values are yes / no / scalar (confirmed). But the result is set at 'determined', while the settlement timer runs and disputes are possible (determined → disputed/amended → finalized). Counting at 'determined' is earlier than the official settled state.
checks.action: Flag on the Flagged page; show 'determined' and 'finalized' separately (change request CR-2).

checks.check: GET /series?category= is exact, case-sensitive, and matches the series categories list
checks.note: Live check: category=Economics, Crypto and Culture each return series whose categories array contains that exact value (S15, S16, S18).

checks.check: The 'Culture' category used to rank the Culture topic exists in the official taxonomy
checks.note: The official tags_by_categories keys are: AI, Business, Climate and Weather, Commodities, Companies, Crypto, Economics, Elections, Entertainment, Financials, Health, Mentions, Politics, Science and Technology, Social, Sports, Test, World, harrison-test. 'Culture' is not a key. Yet two live demo series return categories ["Culture"] (e.g. KXXBANNEDGROK), and only 2 series were returned for that filter.
checks.action: Flag: the Culture topic rests on an undocumented category with very thin demo coverage (change request CR-3).

checks.check: Golf is selected via the official tag
checks.note: Golf series carry tag 'Golf' under category 'Sports' (e.g. KXPGABIRDIES, KXPGAMASTERS). Golf is a tag, not a category. Official taxonomy lists Golf under Sports.

checks.check: Gas prices are selected via category Economics
checks.note: Gas series exist under Economics (e.g. KXAAAGASCDOK 'Oklahoma gas price', categories [Economics, Commodities], tags [Oil and energy, Econ Daily]). The official taxonomy has no gas category or gas tag. Economics also holds diesel, CPI and other series, so gas membership depends on a title rule, not an official field.
checks.action: Keep the rule but label it as a heuristic on the Flagged page (change request CR-3).

checks.check: GET /events accepts status, with_nested_markets and series_ticker as used
checks.note: status and with_nested_markets confirmed from the events page and lifecycle FAQ (status filter matches child markets). The limit ≤ 200 cap is cited in code comments; the schema table was not re-read here.

checks.check: Event category field read for topic classification
checks.note: Event objects include a category field.

checks.check: orderbook_fp.yes_dollars / no_dollars parsed as [price_dollars, count_fp] ascending, best bid last
checks.note: The collector also falls back to a legacy 'orderbook' key; the current official response does not use it. The fallback is harmless.

checks.check: Implied ask = 1 − best opposite bid
checks.note: Official: YES ask = $1.00 − highest NO bid; NO ask = $1.00 − highest YES bid.

checks.check: depth query parameter used with a valid value
checks.note: Official: depth 0 (default) = all levels; 1–100 = best N levels per side; outside 0–100 returns 400.

checks.check: Candlestick path, required params and allowed period_interval
checks.note: GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks with start_ts, end_ts, period_interval ∈ {1, 60, 1440}.

checks.check: Candle price fields read by the charts and the jump scanner
checks.note: price.close_dollars, yes_bid.close_dollars, yes_ask.close_dollars, end_period_ts.

checks.check: 'Seconds' chart is labelled as client-sampled, not official
checks.note: Official candlesticks have a 1-minute minimum, so sub-minute views must be sampled by the client. The label says so.

checks.check: GET /markets/trades called with valid parameters and fields
checks.note: Official params: ticker, min_ts, max_ts, limit (≤ 1000), cursor, is_block_trade. Trade fields: yes_price_dollars, count_fp, created_time. The plural market_tickers parameter is not used by any file here.

checks.check: include_volume=true and volume_fp used for series ranking
checks.note: Official: include_volume adds total volume across the series' events; series object has volume_fp.

checks.check: GET /markets?tickers=… used for paper-position quotes
checks.note: Parameter table (read in this pass, chunk 1 of 16): tickers — "Comma-separated list of market tickers to retrieve."

checks.check: Order body for POST /portfolio/events/orders contains every required field
checks.note: Required: ticker, side, count, price, time_in_force, self_trade_prevention_type. Both desks send all six. client_order_id is optional and not sent.
checks.action: Optional: send client_order_id for idempotency (change request CR-4).

checks.check: side semantics and number formats
checks.code: exec-desk/js/trade-exec.js:97-107 (bid = buy YES, ask = sell YES); decision/js/trading.js:80-82 (count toFixed(2), price 4 dp)
checks.note: Official: side bid = buy YES, ask = sell YES; count and price are strings (e.g. "10.00", "0.5600").

checks.check: Positions response fields read by the portfolio views
checks.note: market_positions[].position_fp, market_exposure_dollars, realized_pnl_dollars, fees_paid_dollars, total_traded_dollars.

checks.check: Positions query parameters settlement_status=all and count_filter=position
checks.note: Parameter table (chunk 1 of 12): settlement_status enum is unsettled (default), settled, all; count_filter accepts position and total_traded (OR-combined). Both values used by the code are documented.
checks.action: None. CR-5 closed: no parameter change needed.

checks.check: RSA-PSS SHA-256 with salt = digest length (32), message = timestamp + METHOD + path without query
checks.note: Every signer in the repo uses the digest-length salt that the official page specifies.

checks.check: Signer never uses an undocumented salt length for live calls
checks.note: The official page specifies DIGEST_LENGTH only. A 401 retry with another salt is not documented and can hide a real cause (official 401 causes: header_timestamp_expired, authentication_error; the page says to read the details field). A retry on a rejected request does not create an order, so no duplicate order results.
checks.action: Retry only on timestamp errors, or remove the fallback (change request CR-6).

checks.check: Ed25519 keys are signed directly, not with PSS
checks.note: Both desks import PKCS8 Ed25519 keys and sign the message directly, as the official page specifies.

checks.check: Private key handling on a public static site
checks.code: exec-desk/trades.html:24-25 (text: PEM key 'stored ONLY in this browser's localStorage')
checks.note: The official page says the private key is downloaded as a PEM file and must be stored securely. A PEM private key kept in localStorage on a public GitHub Pages origin can be read by any script on that origin. This is a high-severity review item, not a verified exploit.
checks.action: Flag for review. Prefer the local signer tools/kalshi-signer.mjs. Do not paste production keys (change request CR-7).

checks.check: Signed (authenticated) requests never go through the third-party relay
checks.code: exec-desk/js/trade-exec.js:69 (fetch to CFG.demoRest directly); relay limited to public reads: exec-desk/js/kalshi.js:5, exec-desk/js/config.js:13-15
checks.note: Code-path check. The relay (api.allorigins.win) carries public market-data GETs only when direct access is blocked. It is still a third party that sees the request URLs.

checks.check: Demo prices may not reflect real markets
checks.code: exec-desk and decision pages carry the caveat
checks.note: Official wording: 'The price and behavior of markets in the demo environment may not be reflective of those in real markets.'

checks.check: Polling cadences respect official rate limits
checks.note: Official budgets read (chunks 0-1 of 11). Predictions Read budget: Basic 200/s, Advanced 300/s, Expert 600/s, Premier 1,200/s, Paragon 2,400/s, Prime 4,800/s, Prestige 12,000/s; default cost 10 tokens. The code (exec-desk/js/config.js:17-22) polls markets every 15 s, events 30 s, book 5 s, quotes 2 s. Request count per cycle and the account tier are not known here, so compliance cannot be computed.
checks.action: Leave UNVERIFIED. Owner to state polled-market count and tier, then compute against the budgets above.

checks.check: Browser calls to the official API from the GitHub Pages origin succeed (CORS)
checks.note: The audit sandbox has no browser and cannot test CORS from the github.io origin. Earlier evidence is in data/cors.json (another session). Not re-verified here.
checks.action: Keep as UNVERIFIED-01 on the Flagged page.

checks.action: Change the slug to get-market-orderbook in build_site.py and README.md (change request CR-8).

change_requests.request: Make the 'open' view match the official open filter (active only), or split into unopened / paused / open.
Show 'determined' (result known, settlement timer running, disputes possible) separately from 'finalized' (settled).
Label 'Culture' as not present in the official taxonomy, and label the gas title rule under Economics as a heuristic. Show the Flagged note on the page.
Optional: send a client_order_id (≤ 64 chars, allowed set) so retries can be de-duplicated.
CLOSED in this pass: settlement_status=all and count_filter=position are documented in the get-positions parameter table. No change needed.
Remove the MAX_LENGTH salt retry, or restrict it to timestamp errors. The official page documents only the digest-length salt.
Remove private-key storage from the browser on the public site, or document it as a high-risk option for review. Prefer a local signer.
